observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== /etc/hosts (container) ==="; cat /etc/hosts
echo "=== any other backend process? ==="; ps aux | grep -E "green-ecolution|bacon|cargo run" | grep -v grep
echo "=== compose ps ==="; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' | sort
echo "=== any traefik router for localhost auth? ==="; grep -rn "auth" .docker/infra/traefik/ 2>/dev/null | head
echo "=== backend log: repeated background jwks failures ==="; grep -ac "jwks fetch failed" /tmp/backend.log; echo "(count of jwks fetch failures)"
